name: notes-app
description: Production-ready Simple Note app with Bun, Elysia, React, and SQLite

scripts.install:all: bun install --cwd backend --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd frontend --frozen-lockfile
scripts.build: bun run --cwd frontend build && bun run --cwd backend build
scripts.build:hostman: bun run install:all && bun run build && bun run migrate
scripts.hostman: bun run --cwd backend migrate && bun run --cwd backend serve
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run --cwd frontend typecheck
